name: Teqnion AB (publ)
summary: Teqnion AB (publ), through its subsidiaries, engages in marketing and selling components, machines, systems, and services. The company offers industrial components and engineering products, such as RFID- and Ex-solutions, sensor technology, connectors, solenoids, and breaks and clutches for telecom, process, automation, medicine technology, and packing and labeling industries. It also provides energy systems, such as stirling generators, heat production systems, inverters, batteries and chargers, UPS, lightning protection equipment, earthing material, and equipotential systems for electricians, wind power projects, service vehicle production, shipyards, weather stations, houses, military hospitals, and rescue equipment markets. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Solna, Sweden.
